title: UserAuthCertificate - Data API
description: Represents a user authentication certificate in your org. A user certificate is a unique PEM-encoded X.509 digital certificate to authenticate individual users to your org. This object is available in API version 45.0 and later.

CertificateChain.description: The uploaded PEM files can contain a single certificate or up to 10 certificates in a certificate chain. Uploaded PEM files can’t be larger than 1 MB.

CertificateChainLength.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
CertificateChainLength.description: The auto-generated length of the certificate or certificate chain in the uploaded PEM file.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name of the object in the API. This name can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters, and must be unique in your org. It must begin with a letter, not include spaces, not end with an underscore, and not contain two consecutive underscores. When creating large sets of data, always specify a unique DeveloperName for each record. If no DeveloperName is specified, Salesforce generates one for each record, which slows performance. Note: Only users with View DeveloperName OR View Setup and Configuration permission can view, group, sort, and filter this field.

ExpirationDate.description: The expiration date of the uploaded certificate.

Fingerprint.description: The unique fingerprint of the uploaded certificate.

Language.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Language.description: The language in which to display the certificate. Possible values are: da (Danish) de (German) en_US (English) es (Spanish) es_MX (Spanish - Mexico) fi (Finnish) fr (French) it (Italian) ja (Japanese) ko (Korean) nl_NL (Dutch) no (Norwegian) pt_BR (Portuguese - Brazil) ru (Russian) sv (Swedish) th (Thai) zh_CN (Chinese - Simplified) zh_TW (Chinese - Traditional)

MasterLabel.description: A descriptive name for the certificate.

SerialNumber.description: The serial number of the uploaded certificate.

UserID.description: The user associated with the certificate.

special_access_rules: This object is only available in orgs with Let users authenticate with a certificate enabled in Identity Verification. Only users with the Manage Internal Users permission can access this object.
